findings.summary: Delete the dictionary-member read arm propertyRead already had above it.

collectMutatedContainerSymbols reuses rootIdentifier, unwrapExpression, the shared mutatingCallTarget write-shape recognizer (also writesThroughRoot's) and data-methods' writeReceiverMethods instead of a fifth mutating-method list.
One isMutatedContainer predicate for planEntryState and moduleVariableSymbols; the two initializer predicates unwrap through unwrapExpression.

One iteratorMethodCall recognizer in syntax.ts for the tuple loop and the runtime range; the classification runs inside the probe so a declined iterator commits nothing, and the tuple loop hands every other receiver straight to the runtime loop instead of probing twice.
dictionary.name = value reuses dictionaryEntryTarget, which now asks declaredAsDictionary before probing, so a plain field store never pays for a discarded owner resolution.
emitLogicalAssignment returns void and refuses in place; the guard and the guarded store are logicalAssignmentGuard and emitGuardedStore, shared by the scalar, data-path and dictionary-entry arms.
in and Object.hasOwn share membershipCpp on the data lowerer.
Object statics dispatch through one OBJECT_STATIC_HANDLERS map; the set plus switch and the unreachable fallthrough are gone.
booleanValue and staticStringValue builders in types.ts replace the literal spellings in object-statics, expressions and error-values; Boolean() returns the builder's value.

throw new Error(x) compiles through the Error value lowering (compileErrorConstruction, consumer thrown) and thrownMessage instead of re-reading the constructor argument; a { cause } option is accepted and dropped.
text += number|boolean reuses stringConcatPart, now a module function, through bbl::js::concat_append.
emitRuntimeForOf decides the indexed element once; the unreachable item arm is gone.
argumentValues picks its sink once per argument; a numeric tuple spread binds through bindDataTuple and tupleComponents.
Array destructuring validates the rest binding's identifier once, without the BindingElement cast.
bindCopiedDefault shared by the vector-lane and struct-field destructuring defaults.
withRecordScopes takes the callable and derives the this binding itself instead of a caller-computed flag.
Type-argument frames read through one typeArgumentFrames() in the key, the lookup and the emptiness test; each frame's key is spelled once when pushed.
The unifier's visited set is keyed by type identity, without the id cast or typeToString.
fromIndexSignatureType is asked after the symbol-named lookups, which cost less and never describe a dictionary.
compileArrayFromMapped skips the object-literal allocation form before probing.
DataView setters reuse to_uint32 (forward-declared) instead of a private modulo copy.
number_to_string_radix appends digits and reverses once instead of inserting at the front.
string_pad_start/end share pad_needed and append_fill with one allocation; the trims and parse_float share the whitespace scans; string_char_at keeps one guard.

Unused exports dropped (restParameterIndex, collectMutatedContainerSymbols, objectIdentityCallArgument); the identity ternary in the typed-array view spelling and stringCpp's restatement of the string sink removed.
compileArrayFromMapped could reuse emitArrayCallbackLoop's scaffold.
findings.blockedBy: The array-callback loop is keyed to vector/span receivers and argument 0, while Array.from's walk also covers sets, maps and typed arrays; a range-generic scaffold does not exist yet.

findings.summary: mentionsTypeParameter duplicates mentionsSubstitution's walk.
findings.blockedBy: mentionsSubstitution is defined by the frames in force and feeds the struct-identity key; a shared walk changes which instantiations share a cached struct.

findings.summary: emitLogicalAssignment could emit the plain store under the guard instead of restating the scalar and data-path stores.
findings.blockedBy: The plain assignment lowering takes the BinaryExpression and reads its operator; splitting it into emitStore(left, operator, right) restructures the pre-existing path beyond this diff.

findings.summary: Library-global recognition is spelled per site with three alias tests (isDefaultLibraryIdentifier, !lookupOptional, none).
findings.blockedBy: The pre-existing String/Number/Object.keys sites test aliases with lookupOptional; one symbol-derived resolver means migrating them, outside the diff. The two analysis predicates without a library test over-approximate conservatively.

findings.summary: Module-state container-ness could come from the declared type, and record-with-methods is a this-binding question for the storage planner.
findings.blockedBy: The planner runs before the registry can classify a type without allocating a struct name; needs the classification/materialization split below.

findings.summary: dictionary.name could canonicalize into the element access so every map arm applies.
findings.blockedBy: The element-access lowering takes the syntax node; canonicalizing needs a Value-level lookup entry point. The write arm now shares dictionaryEntryTarget with the logical assignment.

findings.summary: DataTypeRegistry classification is coupled to struct-name allocation, so callers add checker pre-gates.
findings.blockedBy: A registry refactor: naming a struct at its first emitted use rather than at classification.

findings.summary: A caught or constructed Error is a record/string hybrid flagged nativeError rather than an Error value kind.
findings.blockedBy: Needs a native exception carrying name, message and cause.

findings.summary: Object.assign(engineHandle, {...}) should refuse or lower to property writes rather than erase.
findings.blockedBy: camera-mutations and node-geometry tests pin the erased shape.

findings.summary: The receiver's type arguments could be one more frame on the call stack instead of a slot defineThis overwrites.
findings.blockedBy: defineThis owns the receiver slot and withRecordScopes restores it around every record scope; pushing it as a frame changes that restore order. The three readers now go through typeArgumentFrames().
